track.title: Shur, Mahur (part 1)
track.notes: First 4:07 of the track 'Shur, Mahur' (two disc sides): the Shur. The rest of the track sounds about 20 cents lower and is catalogued as part 2.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C#6 and dwells most on B in Shur. The line peaks at C#6 (1094.7 Hz) at 1:56.3. It closes on Cs4, not the tonic (A4 → B4 → Cs5 → Cs5 → A4 → Cs4).
